verdict.rationale: Chroma Cloud provides multi-node scale. A community post describes it as having "sharding via collections, distributed scaling," with object-storage tiering. First-party docs advertise BYOC in your VPC, multi-cloud/multi-region replication and a serverless, scalable system. Scaling is handled automatically rather than by the operator managing shards. However, the distributed capability is only evidenced for the managed Cloud/BYOC offering, not for a self-hosted open-source cluster. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the sharding/distributed architecture, evidence of a self-hosted multi-node or sharded deployment, operator-level controls over shard placement, and hands-on corroboration of scaling behavior.
